lookupPatient.description: Normalize a caller phone snippet and optionally match the proof-of-concept patient registry. Use it after the caller says a number to get phone.readbackPrompt and phone.normalizedE164. found=false must not block handoff.

checkAvailability.description: Return appointment availability for a known visit type and date/time preference in Europe/Warsaw. Use specific_time for exact hours, morning/afternoon/evening for broad windows, first_available for nearest slots, and consultation when service is unclear. spokenLabel/spokenTime are preferred, and label stays speech-safe.

messages.content: Przepraszam, mam chwilowy problem ze sprawdzeniem terminów.

searchKnowledgeBase.description: Answer non-medical clinic questions from the local knowledge base, including organizational details, services, and confirmed pricing. If the result is missing or uncertain, say so and do not invent details.

messages.content: Przepraszam, mam chwilowy problem z wyszukaniem tej informacji.

createEvent.description: Create a booking only after the caller selected one slot and confirmed the summary. Pass the selected slot's slotStart and slotEnd exactly. Include service, timezone, language, patient full name, and confirmed phone number. Never confirm booking before success.

messages.content: Przepraszam, nie udało mi się teraz zapisać wizyty.

createReceptionTask.description: Create a receptionist follow-up only after the caller's full name and repeated phone number are confirmed. Pass taskType, patient full name, patient phone, and only structured optional fields such as serviceBucket or preferredCallbackWindow. Do not add free-text notes.

messages.content: Jeszcze chwila, kończę zapisywać prośbę dla recepcji.
Przepraszam, nie udało mi się teraz zapisać prośby dla recepcji.

sendSmsToReceptionists.description: Send the internal receptionist SMS only after createReceptionTask returned success and you have its taskId. This is internal-only. If it fails, the saved reception task still exists.

sendSmsToPatient.description: Send a manual booking-confirmation SMS only after createEvent succeeded. Pass the calendarEventId, patient identity, appointment timing, booked service, and prefer the live caller number when available.
